name: Schema Tools Test
description: GUI test of the schema tools in rpg_plus: the Data Editor window lists the described kinds, a new item in rpg_plus_game gets an equip type and a trait through the form (a list card with a stat picker), is saved and is gear the game knows at once (its Equip type is picked, not typed); a quest with two steps, a skill and a status made through pickers are known to the game after Save; the command palette builds 'action stat.add stat=str value=2', reports an unknown stat as an error, and inserts the line into an open scenario editor. The new file and the locale edits are removed again. Activated by --itest=schema_tools_edit with --game=rpg_plus --new.
